top_signals.title: Australia Regulator Halts Another Credit Fund Amid Crackdown
top_signals.summary: Australia’s securities regulator temporarily barred Fidante Partners Ltd. from offering units in a credit fund, extending a clampdown on private credit investments amid concerns over risks to investors.
